result.title: Unsupervised Feature Selection Using Local Intrinsic Dimensionality -- Extended Version
result.comment: Preprint submitted to Elsevier Pattern Recognition
result.summary: High dimensionality degrades both the efficiency and the effectiveness of learning algorithms, and in many applications no class labels are available to guide dimensionality reduction. This paper proposes LIDFS, an unsupervised feature selection method based on Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (LID). The method builds on the formal equivalence between LID and the indiscriminability of distance measures. The data matrix is transposed so that each feature is treated as a point, and the LID of each feature is estimated by maximum likelihood from the distances to its $k$ nearest neighboring features. Features with lower LID exhibit greater local discriminability and receive higher importance scores. A refinement step then retains one representative per feature neighborhood and demotes locally redundant features. The result is a complete ranking from which any number of features can be selected without rerunning the procedure. LIDFS does not use any information about labels or the number of classes, and runs in $\mathcal{O}(d^2 n)$ time for $n$ instances and $d$ features. LIDFS is compared with classic and state-of-the-art methods and a random baseline on 23 high-dimensional datasets, the classic benchmark collection. The evaluation uses classification accuracy and AUC with five downstream classifiers, as well as clustering accuracy and normalized mutual information, over both full and aggressive selection ranges. LIDFS ranks first in the supervised evaluations and first or tied second in the clustering-based evaluations. It belongs to the top statistical group together with methods that require the number of classes, and it runs faster than its closest competitor. Several recent methods, by contrast, fail to outperform the random baseline. A sensitivity analysis shows that small neighborhood sizes yield the best results.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LIDFS：把数据矩阵转置、将每个特征视为样本点，用其到 k 个最近邻特征的局部内在维度（LID）估计值作为重要性分数，并去除邻域内冗余特征，从而在无监督下输出完整特征排序，在 23 个高维数据集上评测分类与聚类表现。
AI.relevance_reason: LID 以「距离不可区分性」刻画局部表示几何，这一度量思路或可迁移到 LVR 中判断视觉细节或内部状态是否保留局部可区分性、以及筛选信息量高的视觉特征，但论文本身只涉及表格特征选择，需核查其可用性。
